answer_1.quote: Across three medical Visual Question Answering (VQA) and report generation benchmarks, including radiology and ophthalmology, our empirical results demonstrate that RULE effectively improves the factual accuracy of Med-LVLMs
answer_1.outputs: answers to medical questions and medical reports

answer_2.quote: For Med-VQA task, we use Accuracy as the primary metric and, for detailed comparisons, we also adopt Precision, Recall, and F1 Score. For report generation task, we use BLEU Score, ROUGE-L and METEOR as the metrics.
